explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma that builds a complex manifold structure from holomorphic (complex-differentiable) chart transitions. Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold contains no occurrence of `DifferentiableOn ℂ`. The closest result is `isManifold_of_contDiffOn` in `Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/Basic.lean`, but it needs `ContDiffOn` hypotheses. To use it, you would first upgrade complex differentiability to smoothness with `DifferentiableOn.contDiffOn`. That lemma needs an open set, so you would also have to show the set is open using `I.Boundaryless`. That combines several substantial results, and the library's own proof also goes through its ω-version lemma. A search for other `IsManifold ... of_...` constructors found nothing more.
